name: Obama Awards Obama A Medal
look: An edited photo from a White House ceremony with gold curtains and flags. Barack Obama, eyes lowered, fastens a medal on a blue ribbon around the neck of a second, grinning Barack Obama whose face was edited in.
use: Self-congratulation for a tiny or self-serving achievement. Both men are labeled me, or the caption describes rewarding yourself for something you did for your own benefit.
slots: who receives the medal, usually me (left)
examples: Me for getting out of bed
Me after fixing the bug I wrote
describe: obama putting a medal on himself
man hanging a medal around his own neck
two obamas, one awarding the other a medal
giving yourself a medal for doing nothing
origin: An edit of a photo of Barack Obama presenting the Presidential Medal of Freedom, with the recipient's face swapped for Obama's own.
